12 October 2026 — original government acquisition checkpoint.

Fixed XL: **233 catalogue-installed / 288 absent of 521**. Whole-map reporting: **346,108 source forms**, 4,516 enhanced forms and 6,649 native asset entries. Forms/assets are not unique physical buildings. These checkpoints add **zero installations**.

ROOT independently verified exact completed jobs on pinned Neon (billowing-surf-67227217 / br-icy-silence-b3wjwz0q / neondb) and every literal evidence reference:

- Upton full actual-draw correspondence: job 0e2e21303c85bf1931bb3634db092af8c48a6cd2d5d678c665d605ea4321a7d6, all 8,326 refs verified; pushed 8a982be5e. All 10,770 actual terrain faces are accounted for, including 28 unchanged fallback faces and 280 degenerate faces without support credit. Previous complete four-world ordinary-clearance proofs remain bound; diagnostic negatives remain preserved.
- Upton inherited-overlap metadata replay: job edcb7cda94e072d5808f72d47fbcd9f586439ecd0dce6cc0e899fd58ccbe997a, all 8,338 refs verified; pushed 3d0917148. Geometry-bound metadata alone now passes the unchanged terrain validator; numeric geometry is exactly unchanged. Runtime/foundation/current-neighbour checks and source-specific assembly roles remain pending. A first raw-physical attempt stopped before computation on one historical app.js reference; its failed receipt is preserved and the reviewed exact-byte archive routing correction is authorised. This is not installation acceptance.
- Southside actual-production BASIC extent and private terrain: job 1be4acb6a5e52787ecc57dd7806df25dc4d5281fa6e94b6858a5ea2c14b2cfae, all 8,082 refs verified; pushed 264d3d8d8. All 1,238 scanned forms remain accounted for: 117 affected / 1,121 strictly disjoint; all 46 protective resources retained and 124 actual resource keys released. Private construction accounts for all 774,477 source terrain facets. Candidate has 78,016 faces, exceeding the unchanged 25,000 budget, and fails the unchanged overlapping-height validator. Held reasons remain durable; saved-lineage locality/layer analysis is underway without a new source decode, geometry simplification or budget change.
- PolyU Sports Centre original source and official-map context: pushed 43b7d251d. Current surviving-neighbour finite contacts: job ab6777e2a68b46a3727ebfac7912e95d8106ad878c5b251fbcb9042c2c690e49, all 286 refs verified; pushed 9f8d528bc. All 10 bindings / 8 proofs retain the unchanged 10,536 source faces, 21 bodies and four zero facets. Actual Pao complex, Innovation and Communal contacts are measured; historical Lee source is suppressed by Pao. Both original hold reasons remain in Neon. Surface contacts and schematic maps alone establish neither solid collision nor ownership. Saved-witness classification and legible contact-subset views are proceeding; no acceptance.
- West Wing contact graph: job fea35274bc537fa0c417a75bf63128fc688b125d5a5cd1a1713fa2f31ba76dbb, all 1,640 refs verified; pushed 0b6c39a27. Conditional source-contact reachability supplies no physical main-body root. Fresh raw/owned identity receipt-only recovery job c58f64cb891d9a23d20ddcee9d891cbd1c83219e483c60416522eec246039d3c, all 785 refs verified; pushed f4101f0f5. Identity remains held: 83.3738% target coverage, 17.2976 m excess extent and 11.8497 m² foreign projected excess. No corruption or permanent rejection is inferred.

Original government geometry, surveyed placement and 1× scale stay unchanged; **zero AI geometry modelling**. Existing completed mathematics are reused. Full XL completion is unproven and the issues remain open.

GitHub Astra branch was pulled with --ff-only and is current. Optimisation skill 1.0.0, registry/runtime documents and pinned connection contract are read. No migration rerun, optimisation plans/jobs, derived variants or optimisation publication were started.
